text: とおくに　すむ　カレと　ポケモンの　こうかんが　したいわ

structure.jp: とおくに　すむ　カレと
structure.en: with my boyfriend who lives far away

structure.jp: ポケモンの　こうかんが　したいわ

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: とおくに　すむ　カレ
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase right before a person describes that person. とおくに すむ カレ = 'my boyfriend who lives far away'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.span: こうかんが　したい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb stem means 'want to do'; the thing wanted can take が. こうかんが したい = 'I want to do a trade'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end, said softly, is a feminine way of showing feeling. したいわ = 'I'd so like to'.
